scenes.setting: Warm cream classroom with a low sage table and a plain round wooden shape disk; no other people or anthropomorphic props.
scenes.lighting: Soft warm daylight, diffuse shadows, restrained pastel storybook palette; no oversaturation.
scenes.camera: Stable child-eye medium-wide view, slow move toward the circular disk.
scenes.action: Milo lifts the plain wooden disk, traces its round edge with an index finger, then gives the audience time to repeat.
